[🏕️] Welcome to Disventure ROBLOX Camp!
A thrilling ROBLOX gameshow based on Odd Nation Cartoons' "Disventure Camp" series!

[🕵️🎮] Play incognito as a randomly assigned (or chosen) character,
and compete in a variety of challenges prepared by your hosts!

Work with your team through the early phase, and fight solo once you hit the merge!
Win IMMUNITY to stay in the game and claim the Grand Prize!

Build friendships, form alliances... and outlast everyone else to become the ultimate champion!
Are you ready to outwit, outplay, and outlast at Disventure ROBLOX Camp? 🔥
